visual_decision: rejected: MIX does not improve readability at unchanged alpha
scope: Two bounded fixed-art comparisons only; original A89/214 and actual Game/RuneCamera; no gameplay, target-hardware or AAA approval.
only_visual_delta: Actual trail material uses BLEND_MODE_MIX instead of ADD. Alpha .34 distal/.035 base, tint8bd9cb, geometry, sample lifetime and history remain unchanged.
findings: MIX avoids a luminous wash but blends the pale mint into sunlit stone, making the already subtle .24s trail harder to distinguish.
No opaque fan appears at unchanged alpha; this does not compensate for reduced contrast.
At this default rear-camera .24s pose the blade/trail is partly edge-on. MIX cannot resolve that geometric visibility limit.
Retain ADD for this restrained preview baseline. Real-speed multi-enemy readability and final art approval remain pending.
